verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API, and an API platform could plausibly offer background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to set up autonomous, recurring automations. The Batch API is a one-off asynchronous job submission, not a recurring or autonomous automation. Server-side MCP tool orchestration runs only inside a single request, so it is at most a developer building block.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
